title: BADM Packages Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the BADM packages configuration file.

packages.description: Defines package managers, installation scopes, and packages to install.

packageManagers.description: A map of package managers and their installation commands.

additionalProperties.description: The command used to install packages with this package manager.

dependsOn.description: Name of another installation scope that this scope depends on.

packages.description: List of packages to install using the defined package managers.

items.description: Name of the package to install.
Name of a script to execute after package installation.

scripts.description: Defines scripts that can be referenced in installation scopes.

exec.description: The command or script to execute (can be multi-line).

shell.description: The shell in which the script will be executed (e.g., 'bash').
